architecture.product_repo: KeepLab-Relay (backend/** plus the enumerated Android auth/sync surface are writable in this milestone; everything else under app/ is read-only)
architecture.product_stack: Kotlin 2.3.21, Jetpack Compose + Material 3, Navigation 3, Hilt, Room 2.8.4 (KSP), AGP 9.2.1 — extended by M2 with an HTTP client, WorkManager, a Keystore-backed session store and (optionally) Credential Manager for password UX

new_packages: data/auth/** (session repository, token store, auth client)
data/sync/** (outbox drain, delta apply, sync worker)
extended_packages: data/local/** (schema bump, outbox entity, checkpoint entity, client UUIDs for checklist items and labels, DAOs)
ui/navigation/**, ui/home/**, ui/editor/**, ui/archive/**, ui/labels/**, ui/trash/**, ui/note/**
android_under_construction.tests: app/src/test/** (JVM only; no androidTest, no benchmark)
android_under_construction.explicitly_absent_from_m2: attachments, collaboration, multi-account, push/FCM, conflict-resolution UI, account deletion, automatic Trash retention, CRDT, Google/Firebase identity, passkeys, database encryption

backend_under_construction.build_model: INDEPENDENT_GRADLE_PROJECT with its own backend/settings.gradle.kts and backend/build.gradle.kts
backend_under_construction.wrapper: the existing repository wrapper, reused as-is (Gradle 9.5.1)
backend_under_construction.stack: Kotlin 2.4.20 + Ktor 3.6.0 (Netty) · PostgreSQL via HikariCP + JDBC · Flyway migrations · portable Docker assets (untouched, not executed)
backend_under_construction.m2_additions: A3 auth/session module + auth data schema + token services; A4 sync module + sync data schema + change log/cursor + mutation-id dedupe; new Flyway migrations after V1; new KEEPLAB_* secret variables with placeholders only in backend/.env.example

architecture.stack_repo: Google-Android-Agent-Development-Stack (Specification Compiler, Verification Layer, Evaluation Core / Auto-Finalizer, Hermes orchestration kernel)
architecture.hermes: pinned vgit.af90026 (2026.9.24) at /home/zhong/.hermes/hermes-agent; never upgraded, reinstalled or core-patched
architecture.guard: the same unmodified orchestration/hermes/evaluation_adapter/contract_guard.py, invoked by the same fail-closed pre_tool_call hook
architecture.note: M2 is a host-side backend + Android build/unit-test milestone. It provisions no cloud resource, uses no device and executes no Docker asset.

m2_facts.a3_checkpoint: LIGHT — records only, never stops the session
m2_facts.room_schema: current 3 -> next clean version by direct experimental bump; DEV_DATABASE_RESET_REQUIRED = YES; no migration chain authored
m2_facts.primary_key_strategy: KEEP_LONG_LOCAL_PK_ADD_UNIQUE_CLIENT_UUID (extended to checklist items and labels)
m2_facts.token_model: JWT access (short-lived, ~15 min default) + opaque high-entropy rotating refresh (~30 days default) with retry-safe refresh_request_id (D-10)
m2_facts.server_revision: the only conflict authority; stale baseRevision -> 409 REVISION_CONFLICT
m2_facts.client_checkpoint: advances only after a clean transactional delta apply
m2_facts.mutation_dedupe: dedupe claim + apply + revision increment + change-log append in ONE transaction
m2_facts.not_found_rule: 404 never deletes a live local row
m2_facts.account_id_invariant: ISO-1b enforced at creation/update boundaries and by tests
m2_facts.workmanager: one unique note_sync pipeline; ExistingWorkPolicy = A4_IMPLEMENTATION_DECISION
m2_facts.no_push: no push provider, no FCM, no background push architecture
m2_facts.no_cloud: no provisioning, no deployment, no cloud credential
m2_facts.no_device: no adb, no Maestro, no UiAutomator, no instrumentation, no APK install
m2_facts.live_postgres: optional at most once; absence -> LIVE_POSTGRES_INTEGRATION = SKIPPED_TOOL_UNAVAILABLE and LIVE_POSTGRES_CRASH_INJECTION = SKIPPED_TOOL_UNAVAILABLE; never a blocker

guard.package_switch_semantics: The guard resolves its package dir as os.environ['HERMES_CONTRACT_PACKAGE'] or the built-in default. The hook subprocess inherits the Hermes process environment. Setting the variable for the Hermes process points the SAME unmodified guard at this package; no guard, hook or config change is involved.
guard.known_limitation: Hermes configuration, Hermes core and the hook allowlist live OUTSIDE the guard's source_root (/home/zhong/.hermes/...), so the guard's path lists cannot classify them. They are protected by an explicit hard prohibition and stop condition in this contract and in the M2 execution prompt, enforced by fail-closed operator discipline — not by the path list. Stated rather than hidden.
guard.write_intent_note: The guard's terminal write-intent extractor reads a literal '>' anywhere in a shell command as a redirect (MB-A1-003 / MB-A2-008). Drive the guard by files and read-only commands; never inline heredocs or payload-bearing shell text.

contract_notes.supersedes: nothing; the frozen P0B-CLOSE contract and the A0/A1/A2 contract packages remain active and unedited
